routines.name: account_sell_all_at_market_with_books
routines.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION account_sell_all_at_market_with_books(p_account_id INTEGER,
    p_sold JSONB,
    p_errors JSONB,
    p_skipped JSONB,
    p_cash_before JSONB)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE
    v_books JSONB;
BEGIN
    v_books := account_book_close_logic_positions(p_account_id, p_sold);
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'ok', jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(p_errors, '[]'::JSONB)) = 0,
        'account_id', p_account_id,
        'sold_count', jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(p_sold, '[]'::JSONB)),
        'error_count', jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(p_errors, '[]'::JSONB)),
        'skipped_count', jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(p_skipped, '[]'::JSONB)),
        'sold', COALESCE(p_sold, '[]'::JSONB),
        'errors', COALESCE(p_errors, '[]'::JSONB),
        'skipped', COALESCE(p_skipped, '[]'::JSONB),
        'cash_amount_before', p_cash_before,
        'logic_books', v_books
    );
END;
$$;

    p_phase TEXT DEFAULT 'event',
    p_logic_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_security_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_timeframe_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_payload JSONB DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS VOID
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT app_tech_logging_enabled() THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;
    IF COALESCE(btrim(p_thread_key), '') = '' OR COALESCE(btrim(p_operation), '') = '' THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;
    IF p_phase IS NOT NULL AND p_phase NOT IN ('start', 'end', 'event') THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO app_tech_log (
        trace_id, span_id, thread_key, source, operation, phase,
        message, logic_id, security_id, timeframe_id, payload
    ) VALUES (
        gen_random_uuid(),
        replace(gen_random_uuid()::TEXT, '-', ''),
        btrim(p_thread_key),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_source), ''), 'system'),
        btrim(p_operation),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_phase), ''), 'event'),
        p_message,
        p_logic_id,
        p_security_id,
        p_timeframe_id,
        p_payload
    );
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION app_tech_log_event(TEXT, TEXT, TEXT, TEXT, TEXT, INTEGER, INTEGER, INTEGER, JSONB) IS
'Р—Р°РїРёСЃСЊ РІ app_tech_log, РµСЃР»Рё APP_TECH_LOGGING РІРєР»СЋС‡С‘РЅ';

routines.name: app_tech_logging_enabled
routines.description: TRUE, РµСЃР»Рё РІ parameter_values (Default) РІРєР»СЋС‡С‘РЅ APP_TECH_LOGGING
routines.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_tech_logging_enabled()
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT lower(btrim(pv.value)) IN ('1', 'true', 'yes', 'on')
            FROM parameter_values pv
            JOIN parameter_types pt ON pt.id = pv.parameter_type_id
            JOIN parameter_sets ps ON ps.id = pv.parameter_set_id
            WHERE ps.name = 'Default'
              AND pt.short_name = 'APP_TECH_LOGGING'
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        FALSE
    );
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION app_tech_logging_enabled() IS
'TRUE, РµСЃР»Рё РІ parameter_values (Default) РІРєР»СЋС‡С‘РЅ APP_TECH_LOGGING';

routines.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calc_indicator_series_array(p_indicator_code VARCHAR,
    p_series VARCHAR,
    p_security_id INTEGER,
    p_timeframe_id INTEGER,
    p_point_count INTEGER DEFAULT 100,
    p_end_dt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NULL,
    p_period INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_fast_period INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_slow_period INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_signal_period INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_std_dev NUMERIC DEFAULT NULL,
    p_k_period INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_d_period INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_smooth INTEGER DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS TABLE (dt TIMESTAMP, value NUMERIC)
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
    v_formula TEXT;
BEGIN
    SELECT NULLIF(btrim(formula), '') INTO v_formula
    FROM indicators WHERE code = upper(btrim(p_indicator_code));

    IF poly_is_formula(v_formula) THEN
        RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_poly_formula_array(
            v_formula, p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt,
            p_period, p_fast_period, p_slow_period, p_signal_period,
            p_std_dev, p_k_period, p_d_period, p_smooth);
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    CASE upper(btrim(p_indicator_code))
        WHEN 'RSI' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_rsi_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 14), p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'SMA' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_sma_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 20), p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'EMA' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_ema_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 20), p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'MACD' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_macd_array(
                COALESCE(p_fast_period, 12), COALESCE(p_slow_period, 26), COALESCE(p_signal_period, 9),
                p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'BB' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_bb_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 20), COALESCE(p_std_dev, 2.0), p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'DONCHIAN' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_donchian_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 20), p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'ATR' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_atr_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 14), p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'STOCH' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_stoch_array(
                COALESCE(p_k_period, 14), COALESCE(p_d_period, 3), COALESCE(p_smooth, 3),
                p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'CMO' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_cmo_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 14), p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'CCI' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_cci_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 20), p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'ROC' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_roc_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 10), p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'ADX' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_adx_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 14), p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'LINREG' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_linreg_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 20), COALESCE(p_std_dev, 2.0), p_series,
                p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'SQUARE' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_square_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 20), COALESCE(p_std_dev, 2.0), p_series,
                p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        WHEN 'SOLDIERS' THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM calc_ind_soldiers_array(
                COALESCE(p_period, 3), p_series, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, p_point_count, p_end_dt);
        ELSE
            RETURN;
    END CASE;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cleanup_unused_market_data_enabled()

routines.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_future_contract_for_date(p_security_id INTEGER,
    p_date DATE)
RETURNS TABLE (
    prefix VARCHAR(50),
    moex_secid VARCHAR(20),
    expiration_date DATE,
    tbank_figi VARCHAR(50),
    start_date DATE
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        fe.prefix,
        fe.moex_secid,
        fe.expiration_date,
        fe.tbank_figi,
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT fe2.expiration_date + 1
                FROM futures_expirations fe2
                WHERE fe2.security_id = fe.security_id
                  AND fe2.expiration_date < fe.expiration_date
                  AND fe2.is_active = TRUE
                ORDER BY fe2.expiration_date DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            DATE '2000-01-01'
        ) AS start_date
    FROM futures_expirations fe
    WHERE fe.security_id = p_security_id
      AND fe.expiration_date > p_date
      AND fe.is_active = TRUE
    ORDER BY fe.expiration_date ASC
    LIMIT 1;
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION get_future_contract_for_date(INTEGER, DATE) IS
'РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚ С„СЊСЋС‡РµСЂСЃР° РЅР° РґР°С‚Сѓ (Р±Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€Р°СЏ СЌРєСЃРїРёСЂР°С†РёСЏ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ РґР°С‚С‹) Рё start_date РґР»СЏ Р·Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєРё РёСЃС‚РѕСЂРёРё';

routines.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION indicator_signal_default_params(p_code TEXT,
    p_series TEXT)
RETURNS TEXT
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
    SELECT CASE upper(btrim(COALESCE(p_code, '')))
        WHEN 'SMA' THEN 'period=20,series=' || p_series
        WHEN 'EMA' THEN 'period=20,series=' || p_series
        WHEN 'WMA' THEN 'period=20,series=' || p_series
        WHEN 'HMA' THEN 'period=20,series=' || p_series
        WHEN 'ZLEMA' THEN 'period=20,series=' || p_series
        WHEN 'MACD' THEN 'fast=12,slow=26,signal=9,series=' || p_series
        WHEN 'STOCH' THEN 'k=14,d=3,smooth=3,series=' || p_series
        WHEN 'ROC' THEN 'period=10,series=' || p_series
        WHEN 'BB' THEN 'period=20,std_dev=2,series=' || p_series
        WHEN 'KELTNER' THEN 'period=20,multiplier=2,atr_period=10,series=' || p_series
        WHEN 'DONCHIAN' THEN 'period=20,series=' || p_series
        -- 3 РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊРЅС‹Рµ СЃРІРµС‡Рё вЂ” СЂР°Р±РѕС‡РёР№ РїРµСЂРёРѕРґ SOLDIERS (period=20 РЅРµ РґР°С‘С‚ СЃРёРіРЅР°Р»РѕРІ РІРѕРѕР±С‰Рµ).
        WHEN 'SOLDIERS' THEN 'period=3,series=' || p_series
        ELSE 'period=20,series=' || p_series
    END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION insert_indicator_value(p_indicator_id INTEGER,
    p_value_type_id INTEGER,
    p_security_id INTEGER,
    p_timeframe_id INTEGER,
    p_dt TIMESTAMP,
    p_value NUMERIC(18,6)
,
    p_overwrite BOOLEAN
)
RETURNS VOID AS $$
BEGIN
    IF p_overwrite THEN
        INSERT INTO indicator_values (
            indicator_id, indicator_value_type_id, security_id, timeframe_id,
            dt, value
        ) VALUES (
            p_indicator_id, p_value_type_id, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id,
            p_dt, p_value
        )
        ON CONFLICT (indicator_id, indicator_value_type_id, security_id, timeframe_id, dt)
        DO UPDATE SET
            value = EXCLUDED.value;
    ELSE
        INSERT INTO indicator_values (
            indicator_id, indicator_value_type_id, security_id, timeframe_id,
            dt, value
        ) VALUES (
            p_indicator_id, p_value_type_id, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id,
            p_dt, p_value
        )
        ON CONFLICT (indicator_id, indicator_value_type_id, security_id, timeframe_id, dt)
        DO NOTHING;
    END IF;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_backtest_count_open_positions(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_is_shadow BOOLEAN)
RETURNS INTEGER
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM (
        SELECT lt.security_id
        FROM logic_trades lt
        JOIN sides s ON s.id = lt.side_id
        JOIN actions a ON a.id = lt.action_id
        WHERE lt.logic_id = p_logic_id
          AND lt.is_test = TRUE
          AND lt.is_shadow = p_is_shadow
          AND COALESCE(lt.opt_lane, '') = ''
          AND lt.status IN ('filled', 'submitted')
        GROUP BY lt.security_id
        HAVING COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN s.name = 'Open' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN lt.quantity
                WHEN s.name = 'Close' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN -lt.quantity
                WHEN s.name = 'Open' AND a.name = 'Short' THEN lt.quantity
                WHEN s.name = 'Close' AND a.name = 'Short' THEN -lt.quantity
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) > 0
    ) q;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_backtest_diagnose(p_run_id BIGINT,
    p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_tf_id INTEGER,
    p_date_from DATE,
    p_date_to DATE)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
    v_prices INTEGER;
    v_indicators INTEGER;
    v_bars INTEGER;
    v_securities INTEGER;
    v_signals INTEGER;
BEGIN
    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_securities
    FROM logic_securities ls
    WHERE ls.logic_id = p_logic_id AND ls.is_active = TRUE;

    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_signals
    FROM logic_indicator_signals lis
    WHERE lis.logic_id = p_logic_id AND lis.is_active = TRUE;

    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_prices
    FROM prices p
    JOIN logic_securities ls ON ls.security_id = p.security_id
    WHERE ls.logic_id = p_logic_id AND ls.is_active = TRUE
      AND p.timeframe_id = p_tf_id
      AND p.dt::date BETWEEN p_date_from AND p_date_to;

    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_indicators
    FROM indicator_values iv
    JOIN logic_securities ls ON ls.security_id = iv.security_id
    WHERE ls.logic_id = p_logic_id AND ls.is_active = TRUE
      AND iv.timeframe_id = p_tf_id
      AND iv.dt::date BETWEEN p_date_from AND p_date_to;

    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.dt)::INTEGER INTO v_bars
    FROM prices p
    JOIN logic_securities ls ON ls.security_id = p.security_id
    WHERE ls.logic_id = p_logic_id AND ls.is_active = TRUE
      AND p.timeframe_id = p_tf_id
      AND p.dt::date BETWEEN p_date_from AND p_date_to;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'run_id', p_run_id,
        'securities', v_securities,
        'signals', v_signals,
        'prices_in_period', v_prices,
        'indicator_values_in_period', v_indicators,
        'distinct_bars', v_bars,
        'securities_detail', (
            SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                'security_id', ls.security_id,
                'name', s.name,
                'prices_in_period', (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM prices p
                    WHERE p.security_id = ls.security_id
                      AND p.timeframe_id = p_tf_id
                      AND p.dt::date BETWEEN p_date_from AND p_date_to
                ),
                'indicators_in_period', (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM indicator_values iv
                    WHERE iv.security_id = ls.security_id
                      AND iv.timeframe_id = p_tf_id
                      AND iv.dt::date BETWEEN p_date_from AND p_date_to
                ),
                'test_trades', (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM logic_trades lt
                    WHERE lt.logic_id = p_logic_id AND lt.is_test = TRUE
                      AND lt.security_id = ls.security_id
                )
            ) ORDER BY ls.display_order, ls.id), '[]'::jsonb)
            FROM logic_securities ls
            JOIN securities s ON s.id = ls.security_id
            WHERE ls.logic_id = p_logic_id AND ls.is_active = TRUE
        )
    );
END;
$$;

routines.description: РўРµСЃС‚: equity С‡РµРјРїРёРѕРЅР° (Р±РµР· opt_lane) = cash + longГ—price в€’ shortГ—price
routines.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_backtest_portfolio_equity(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_timeframe_id INTEGER,
    p_bar_dt TIMESTAMP,
    p_cash_balance NUMERIC)
RETURNS NUMERIC
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    -- LATERAL вЂ¦ ORDER BY dt DESC LIMIT 1 uses idx_prices_unique_candle (backward).
    -- Old DISTINCT ON (security_id) вЂ¦ JOIN prices caused huge temp sorts (~0.4s+/call).
    WITH pos AS (
        SELECT
            lt.security_id,
            GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN s.name = 'Open' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN lt.quantity
                    WHEN s.name = 'Close' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN -lt.quantity
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0), 0) AS long_qty,
            GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN s.name = 'Open' AND a.name = 'Short' THEN lt.quantity
                    WHEN s.name = 'Close' AND a.name = 'Short' THEN -lt.quantity
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0), 0) AS short_qty
        FROM logic_trades lt
        JOIN sides s ON s.id = lt.side_id
        JOIN actions a ON a.id = lt.action_id
        WHERE lt.logic_id = p_logic_id
          AND lt.is_test = TRUE
          AND lt.is_shadow = FALSE
          AND COALESCE(lt.opt_lane, '') = ''
          AND lt.status IN ('filled', 'submitted')
        GROUP BY lt.security_id
        HAVING GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN s.name = 'Open' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN lt.quantity
                    WHEN s.name = 'Close' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN -lt.quantity
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0), 0) > 0
            OR GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN s.name = 'Open' AND a.name = 'Short' THEN lt.quantity
                    WHEN s.name = 'Close' AND a.name = 'Short' THEN -lt.quantity
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0), 0) > 0
    ),
    px AS (
        SELECT
            pos.long_qty,
            pos.short_qty,
            p.close_price
        FROM pos
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT pr.close_price
            FROM prices pr
            WHERE pr.security_id = pos.security_id
              AND pr.timeframe_id = p_timeframe_id
              AND pr.dt <= p_bar_dt
            ORDER BY pr.dt DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) p
    )
    SELECT COALESCE(p_cash_balance, 0)
         + COALESCE(SUM(px.long_qty * px.close_price - px.short_qty * px.close_price), 0)
    FROM px
    WHERE px.close_price > 0;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION logic_backtest_portfolio_equity(INTEGER, INTEGER, TIMESTAMP, NUMERIC) IS
'РўРµСЃС‚: equity С‡РµРјРїРёРѕРЅР° (Р±РµР· opt_lane) = cash + longГ—price в€’ shortГ—price';

-- MTM РІС‹Р±СЂР°РЅРЅРѕРіРѕ РґРµРЅРµР¶РЅРѕРіРѕ С„РѕРЅРґР° РІ С‚РµСЃС‚Рµ (РёСЃРєР»СЋС‡Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ РёР· Р±Р°Р·С‹ Р»РѕС‚Р° В«РІРµСЃСЊ РїРѕСЂС‚С„РµР»СЊВ»).

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_backtest_sec_shadow(p_run_id BIGINT,
    p_security_id INTEGER)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT COALESCE(
        (SELECT
            COALESCE(real_trading_paused, FALSE)
            OR COALESCE(real_trading_paused_long, FALSE)
            OR COALESCE(real_trading_paused_short, FALSE)
         FROM logic_backtest_security_state
         WHERE run_id = p_run_id AND security_id = p_security_id),
        FALSE
    );
$$;

-- Shadow С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РґР»СЏ СѓРєР°Р·Р°РЅРЅРѕР№ СЃС‚РѕСЂРѕРЅС‹ (long/short).

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_backtest_sec_side_shadow(p_run_id BIGINT,
    p_security_id INTEGER,
    p_position_side TEXT)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT CASE logic_normalize_position_side(p_position_side)
        WHEN 'long' THEN COALESCE(
            (SELECT
                COALESCE(real_trading_paused_long, FALSE)
                OR (
                    COALESCE(real_trading_paused, FALSE)
                    AND NOT COALESCE(real_trading_paused_long, FALSE)
                    AND NOT COALESCE(real_trading_paused_short, FALSE)
                )
             FROM logic_backtest_security_state
             WHERE run_id = p_run_id AND security_id = p_security_id),
            FALSE
        )
        WHEN 'short' THEN COALESCE(
            (SELECT
                COALESCE(real_trading_paused_short, FALSE)
                OR (
                    COALESCE(real_trading_paused, FALSE)
                    AND NOT COALESCE(real_trading_paused_long, FALSE)
                    AND NOT COALESCE(real_trading_paused_short, FALSE)
                )
             FROM logic_backtest_security_state
             WHERE run_id = p_run_id AND security_id = p_security_id),
            FALSE
        )
        ELSE COALESCE(
            (SELECT COALESCE(real_trading_paused, FALSE)
             FROM logic_backtest_security_state
             WHERE run_id = p_run_id AND security_id = p_security_id),
            FALSE
        )
    END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_backtest_selected_cash_fund_mtm(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_timeframe_id INTEGER,
    p_bar_dt TIMESTAMP)
RETURNS NUMERIC
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
    v_code TEXT;
    v_mtm NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    v_code := upper(btrim(COALESCE(
        get_logic_param_text(p_logic_id, 'cash_fund_code'),
        ''
    )));
    IF v_code = '' OR v_code NOT IN ('TMON', 'LQDT', 'SBMM') THEN
        RETURN 0;
    END IF;

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.long_qty * px.close_price), 0)
    INTO v_mtm
    FROM (
        SELECT
            lt.security_id,
            GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN s.name = 'Open' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN lt.quantity
                    WHEN s.name = 'Close' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN -lt.quantity
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0), 0) AS long_qty
        FROM logic_trades lt
        JOIN sides s ON s.id = lt.side_id
        JOIN actions a ON a.id = lt.action_id
        JOIN security_prefixes sp ON sp.security_id = lt.security_id
        WHERE lt.logic_id = p_logic_id
          AND lt.is_test = TRUE
          AND lt.is_shadow = FALSE
          AND COALESCE(lt.opt_lane, '') = ''
          AND lt.status IN ('filled', 'submitted')
          AND upper(sp.prefix) = v_code
        GROUP BY lt.security_id
    ) q
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p.close_price
        FROM prices p
        WHERE p.security_id = q.security_id
          AND p.timeframe_id = p_timeframe_id
          AND p.dt <= p_bar_dt
          AND p.close_price > 0
        ORDER BY p.dt DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) px ON TRUE
    WHERE q.long_qty > 0;

    RETURN GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_mtm, 0));
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION logic_backtest_selected_cash_fund_mtm(INTEGER, INTEGER, TIMESTAMP) IS
'РўРµСЃС‚: MTM РІС‹Р±СЂР°РЅРЅРѕРіРѕ cash_fund_code РЅР° bar_dt (С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ С‡РµРјРїРёРѕРЅ, Р±РµР· opt_lane)';

-- РџР°СЂРєРѕРІРєР°: BUY С„РѕРЅРґР° РЅР° min(СЃРІРѕР±РѕРґРЅС‹Р№ РєСЌС€, equityв€’РїРѕСЂРѕРів€’СѓР¶Рµ_РІ_С„РѕРЅРґРµ); Р±РµР· РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Рё С„РѕРЅРґР°.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_backtest_update_run(p_run_id BIGINT,
    p_status TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
    p_progress_pct NUMERIC DEFAULT NULL,
    p_phase_message TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
    p_phase_detail TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
    p_current_bar_dt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NULL,
    p_processed_bars INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_trades_created INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_test_balance NUMERIC DEFAULT NULL,
    p_financial_result NUMERIC DEFAULT NULL,
    p_error_message TEXT DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS VOID
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    UPDATE logic_backtest_runs r
    SET status = COALESCE(p_status, r.status),
        progress_pct = COALESCE(p_progress_pct, r.progress_pct),
        phase_message = COALESCE(p_phase_message, r.phase_message),
        phase_detail = COALESCE(p_phase_detail, r.phase_detail),
        current_bar_dt = COALESCE(p_current_bar_dt, r.current_bar_dt),
        processed_bars = COALESCE(p_processed_bars, r.processed_bars),
        trades_created = COALESCE(p_trades_created, r.trades_created),
        test_balance = COALESCE(p_test_balance, r.test_balance),
        financial_result = COALESCE(p_financial_result, r.financial_result),
        error_message = COALESCE(p_error_message, r.error_message),
        finished_at = CASE
            WHEN p_status IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'failed') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            ELSE r.finished_at
        END
    WHERE r.id = p_run_id;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_cash_fund_price_at(p_security_id INTEGER,
    p_timeframe_id INTEGER,
    p_bar_dt TIMESTAMP,
    p_code TEXT)
RETURNS NUMERIC
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
    v_price NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    SELECT p.close_price
    INTO v_price
    FROM prices p
    WHERE p.security_id = p_security_id
      AND p.timeframe_id = p_timeframe_id
      AND p.dt <= p_bar_dt
    ORDER BY p.dt DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_price IS NOT NULL AND v_price > 0 THEN
        RETURN v_price;
    END IF;

    SELECT p.close_price
    INTO v_price
    FROM prices p
    WHERE p.security_id = p_security_id
      AND p.dt <= p_bar_dt
    ORDER BY p.dt DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_price IS NOT NULL AND v_price > 0 THEN
        RETURN v_price;
    END IF;

    -- Р‘РџРР¤ РґРµРЅРµР¶РЅРѕРіРѕ СЂС‹РЅРєР° ~100 в‚Ѕ/РїР°Р№. HTTP вЂ” С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РІ live logic_park_excess_cash (resolve).
    RETURN 100;
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION logic_cash_fund_price_at(INTEGER, INTEGER, TIMESTAMP, TEXT) IS
'Р¦РµРЅР° TMON/LQDT/SBMM РґР»СЏ РїР°СЂРєРѕРІРєРё: prices в†’ fallback 100 (Р±РµР· HTTP РЅР° РєР°Р¶РґС‹Р№ Р±Р°СЂ)';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_check_security_resume(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_security_id INTEGER,
    p_timeframe_id INTEGER)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE
    v_ls RECORD;
    v_shadow_track NUMERIC;
    v_resumed BOOLEAN := FALSE;
    v_paused_long BOOLEAN;
    v_paused_short BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
    SELECT
        COALESCE(ls.real_trading_paused_long, FALSE) AS paused_long,
        COALESCE(ls.real_trading_paused_short, FALSE) AS paused_short,
        ls.stop_resume_equity_long,
        ls.stop_resume_baseline_long,
        ls.stop_resume_equity_short,
        ls.stop_resume_baseline_short,
        -- legacy paper-level (РґРѕ v48)
        COALESCE(ls.real_trading_paused, FALSE) AS paused_paper,
        ls.stop_resume_equity,
        ls.stop_resume_baseline
    INTO v_ls
    FROM logic_securities ls
    WHERE ls.logic_id = p_logic_id
      AND ls.security_id = p_security_id;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN FALSE;
    END IF;

    v_paused_long := v_ls.paused_long;
    v_paused_short := v_ls.paused_short;

    -- Legacy: paper pause without side flags в†’ treat as both sides
    IF v_ls.paused_paper AND NOT v_paused_long AND NOT v_paused_short THEN
        v_paused_long := TRUE;
        v_paused_short := TRUE;
        IF v_ls.stop_resume_equity_long IS NULL THEN
            v_ls.stop_resume_equity_long := v_ls.stop_resume_equity;
            v_ls.stop_resume_baseline_long := v_ls.stop_resume_baseline;
        END IF;
        IF v_ls.stop_resume_equity_short IS NULL THEN
            v_ls.stop_resume_equity_short := v_ls.stop_resume_equity;
            v_ls.stop_resume_baseline_short := v_ls.stop_resume_baseline;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    IF v_paused_long
       AND v_ls.stop_resume_equity_long IS NOT NULL
       AND v_ls.stop_resume_baseline_long IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_shadow_track := logic_security_side_track_value(
            p_logic_id, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, TRUE, 'long'
        );
        IF COALESCE(v_ls.stop_resume_baseline_long, 0) + COALESCE(v_shadow_track, 0)
           >= COALESCE(v_ls.stop_resume_equity_long, 0) THEN
            UPDATE logic_securities
            SET real_trading_paused_long = FALSE,
                stop_resume_equity_long = NULL,
                stop_resume_baseline_long = NULL,
                stop_resume_triggered_at_long = NULL,
                real_trading_paused = COALESCE(real_trading_paused_short, FALSE),
                stop_resume_equity = CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(real_trading_paused_short, FALSE) THEN stop_resume_equity
                    ELSE NULL
                END,
                stop_resume_baseline = CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(real_trading_paused_short, FALSE) THEN stop_resume_baseline
                    ELSE NULL
                END,
                stop_resume_triggered_at = CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(real_trading_paused_short, FALSE) THEN stop_resume_triggered_at
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            WHERE logic_id = p_logic_id
              AND security_id = p_security_id;

            PERFORM logic_trade_log(
                p_logic_id,
                'stop.resume',
                format(
                    'Р’РѕР·РѕР±РЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРёРµ СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕР№ Long sec=%s (baseline=%s shadow=%s target=%s)',
                    p_security_id,
                    v_ls.stop_resume_baseline_long,
                    v_shadow_track,
                    v_ls.stop_resume_equity_long
                ),
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'security_id', p_security_id,
                    'position_side', 'long',
                    'baseline', v_ls.stop_resume_baseline_long,
                    'shadow_track', v_shadow_track,
                    'target', v_ls.stop_resume_equity_long
                ),
                p_security_id,
                p_timeframe_id
            );
            v_resumed := TRUE;
            v_paused_long := FALSE;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    IF v_paused_short
       AND v_ls.stop_resume_equity_short IS NOT NULL
       AND v_ls.stop_resume_baseline_short IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_shadow_track := logic_security_side_track_value(
            p_logic_id, p_security_id, p_timeframe_id, TRUE, 'short'
        );
        IF COALESCE(v_ls.stop_resume_baseline_short, 0) + COALESCE(v_shadow_track, 0)
           >= COALESCE(v_ls.stop_resume_equity_short, 0) THEN
            UPDATE logic_securities
            SET real_trading_paused_short = FALSE,
                stop_resume_equity_short = NULL,
                stop_resume_baseline_short = NULL,
                stop_resume_triggered_at_short = NULL,
                real_trading_paused = COALESCE(real_trading_paused_long, FALSE),
                stop_resume_equity = CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(real_trading_paused_long, FALSE) THEN stop_resume_equity
                    ELSE NULL
                END,
                stop_resume_baseline = CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(real_trading_paused_long, FALSE) THEN stop_resume_baseline
                    ELSE NULL
                END,
                stop_resume_triggered_at = CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(real_trading_paused_long, FALSE) THEN stop_resume_triggered_at
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            WHERE logic_id = p_logic_id
              AND security_id = p_security_id;

            PERFORM logic_trade_log(
                p_logic_id,
                'stop.resume',
                format(
                    'Р’РѕР·РѕР±РЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРёРµ СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕР№ Short sec=%s (baseline=%s shadow=%s target=%s)',
                    p_security_id,
                    v_ls.stop_resume_baseline_short,
                    v_shadow_track,
                    v_ls.stop_resume_equity_short
                ),
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'security_id', p_security_id,
                    'position_side', 'short',
                    'baseline', v_ls.stop_resume_baseline_short,
                    'shadow_track', v_shadow_track,
                    'target', v_ls.stop_resume_equity_short
                ),
                p_security_id,
                p_timeframe_id
            );
            v_resumed := TRUE;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    RETURN v_resumed;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_count_open_positions(p_logic_id INTEGER)
RETURNS INTEGER
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM (
        SELECT lt.security_id
        FROM logic_trades lt
        JOIN sides s ON s.id = lt.side_id
        JOIN actions a ON a.id = lt.action_id
        WHERE lt.logic_id = p_logic_id
          AND NOT lt.is_shadow
          AND NOT lt.is_test
          AND COALESCE(lt.opt_lane, '') = ''
          AND lt.status IN ('filled', 'submitted')
        GROUP BY lt.security_id
        HAVING COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN s.name = 'Open' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN lt.quantity
                WHEN s.name = 'Close' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN -lt.quantity
                WHEN s.name = 'Open' AND a.name = 'Short' THEN lt.quantity
                WHEN s.name = 'Close' AND a.name = 'Short' THEN -lt.quantity
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) > 0
    ) q;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_is_paper_balance_text(p_raw TEXT)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN p_raw IS NULL OR btrim(p_raw) = '' THEN TRUE
        WHEN replace(replace(btrim(p_raw), ' ', ''), ',', '.')
            IN ('1000000', '1000000.0', '1000000.00', '1000000.000', '1000000.000000')
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END;
$$;

routines.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_lightning_diagnostics(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_tf_id INTEGER,
    p_bar_dt TIMESTAMP)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
    v_active_signals INTEGER := 0;
    v_active_securities INTEGER := 0;
    v_pending INTEGER := 0;
    v_last_signal_bar TIMESTAMP;
    v_last_signal_count INTEGER := 0;
    v_last_processed TEXT;
    v_non_trading BOOLEAN := FALSE;
    v_price_errors INTEGER := 0;
    v_signal_errors INTEGER := 0;
    v_trade_errors INTEGER := 0;
    v_last_error TEXT;
BEGIN
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_active_signals
    FROM logic_indicator_signals lis
    WHERE lis.logic_id = p_logic_id
      AND lis.is_active = TRUE
      AND lower(COALESCE(lis.position_event, 'open')) = 'open';

    SELECT count(*) INTO v_active_securities
    FROM logic_securities ls
    WHERE ls.logic_id = p_logic_id AND ls.is_active = TRUE;

    SELECT count(*) INTO v_pending
    FROM logic_signal_confirm_pending WHERE logic_id = p_logic_id;

    -- РЎР°РјС‹Р№ СЃРІРµР¶РёР№ Р±Р°СЂ Р»РѕРіРёРєРё, РЅР° РєРѕС‚РѕСЂРѕРј СѓР¶Рµ РµСЃС‚СЊ СЃРёРіРЅР°Р»С‹ РІ С‚РµСЂРјРёРЅР°Р».
    SELECT bar_dt, cnt INTO v_last_signal_bar, v_last_signal_count
    FROM (
        SELECT bar_dt, count(*)::int AS cnt
        FROM logic_terminal_signals
        WHERE logic_id = p_logic_id
        GROUP BY bar_dt
        ORDER BY bar_dt DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) s;

    -- Р‘Р°СЂ, РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹Р№ С†РёРєР» СѓР¶Рµ РѕР±СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°Р» (РґРµРґСѓРї-РјР°СЂРєРµСЂ СЃР°РјРѕР№ Р»РѕРіРёРєРё).
    v_last_processed := NULLIF(
        btrim(COALESCE(get_logic_param_text(p_logic_id, 'terminal_signal_last_bar_dt'), '')),
        '');

    IF p_bar_dt IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_non_trading := logic_skip_signal_by_periods(p_logic_id, p_bar_dt);
    END IF;

    -- РћС€РёР±РєРё РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРёС… РїСЂРѕРіРѕРЅРѕРІ В«РјРѕР»РЅРёРёВ» (Р·Р° 2 С‡Р°СЃР°) вЂ” РїРѕС‡РµРјСѓ С‡Р°СЃС‚СЊ Р±СѓРјР°Рі РЅРµ РїРѕСЃС‡РёС‚Р°Р»Р°СЃСЊ.
    SELECT
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE operation = 'lightning.prices_http_error'),
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE operation = 'lightning.signal_error'),
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE operation = 'lightning.trade_error')
    INTO v_price_errors, v_signal_errors, v_trade_errors
    FROM app_tech_log
    WHERE logic_id = p_logic_id
      AND created_at > now() - interval '2 hours'
      AND operation IN ('lightning.prices_http_error', 'lightning.signal_error', 'lightning.trade_error');

    -- РџРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРµРµ СЃРѕРѕР±С‰РµРЅРёРµ РѕР± РѕС€РёР±РєРµ (РґР»СЏ РїРѕРєР°Р·Р° РїСЂРёС‡РёРЅС‹ РІ UI).
    SELECT a.message INTO v_last_error
    FROM app_tech_log a
    WHERE a.logic_id = p_logic_id
      AND a.created_at > now() - interval '2 hours'
      AND a.operation IN ('lightning.prices_http_error', 'lightning.signal_error', 'lightning.trade_error')
    ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'active_signals', COALESCE(v_active_signals, 0),
        'active_securities', COALESCE(v_active_securities, 0),
        'pending_total', COALESCE(v_pending, 0),
        'last_signal_bar_dt', CASE WHEN v_last_signal_bar IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE to_char(v_last_signal_bar, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') END,
        'last_signal_count', COALESCE(v_last_signal_count, 0),
        'last_processed_bar_dt', v_last_processed,
        'non_trading_period', COALESCE(v_non_trading, FALSE),
        'price_errors', COALESCE(v_price_errors, 0),
        'signal_errors', COALESCE(v_signal_errors, 0),
        'trade_errors', COALESCE(v_trade_errors, 0),
        'last_error', v_last_error
    );
END;
$$;

'РўРѕР»СЊРєРѕ С‡С‚РµРЅРёРµ, Р±РµР· Р·Р°С…РІР°С‚Р° advisory-lock.';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_long_position_qty(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_security_id INTEGER,
    p_is_shadow BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    p_is_test BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    p_opt_lane TEXT DEFAULT '')
RETURNS NUMERIC
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN s.name = 'Open' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN lt.quantity
            WHEN s.name = 'Close' AND a.name = 'Long' THEN -lt.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END
    ), 0), 0)
    FROM logic_trades lt
    JOIN sides s ON s.id = lt.side_id
    JOIN actions a ON a.id = lt.action_id
    WHERE lt.logic_id = p_logic_id
      AND lt.security_id = p_security_id
      AND lt.is_shadow = p_is_shadow
      AND lt.is_test = p_is_test
      AND COALESCE(lt.opt_lane, '') = COALESCE(p_opt_lane, '')
      AND lt.status IN ('filled', 'submitted');
$$;

    -- РќРµС‚РѕСЂРіРѕРІС‹Рµ: РЅРѕС‡СЊ РґРѕ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚РёСЏ, РІРµС‡РµСЂ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ СЃРµСЃСЃРёРё, РІС‹С…РѕРґРЅС‹Рµ С†РµР»РёРєРѕРј.

        (1::SMALLINT, TIME '00:00', TIME '09:59:59', 'РџРЅ РґРѕ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚РёСЏ'),
        (1::SMALLINT, TIME '18:40', TIME '23:59:59', 'РџРЅ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ СЃРµСЃСЃРёРё'),
        (2::SMALLINT, TIME '00:00', TIME '09:59:59', 'Р’С‚ РґРѕ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚РёСЏ'),
        (2::SMALLINT, TIME '18:40', TIME '23:59:59', 'Р’С‚ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ СЃРµСЃСЃРёРё'),
        (3::SMALLINT, TIME '00:00', TIME '09:59:59', 'РЎСЂ РґРѕ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚РёСЏ'),
        (3::SMALLINT, TIME '18:40', TIME '23:59:59', 'РЎСЂ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ СЃРµСЃСЃРёРё'),
        (4::SMALLINT, TIME '00:00', TIME '09:59:59', 'Р§С‚ РґРѕ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚РёСЏ'),
        (4::SMALLINT, TIME '18:40', TIME '23:59:59', 'Р§С‚ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ СЃРµСЃСЃРёРё'),
        (5::SMALLINT, TIME '00:00', TIME '09:59:59', 'РџС‚ РґРѕ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚РёСЏ'),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_open_notional_exposure(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_is_test BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    p_opt_lane TEXT DEFAULT '',
    p_run_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS NUMERIC
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT GREATEST(0, COALESCE(SUM(rem.qty * lt.price), 0))
    FROM logic_trades lt
    JOIN sides s ON s.id = lt.side_id
    JOIN actions a ON a.id = lt.action_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT GREATEST(
            lt.quantity - COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(l.quantity)
                FROM logic_trade_lots l
                WHERE l.open_trade_id = lt.id
            ), 0),
            0
        ) AS qty
    ) rem
    WHERE lt.logic_id = p_logic_id
      AND NOT lt.is_shadow
      AND lt.is_test = p_is_test
      AND COALESCE(lt.opt_lane, '') = COALESCE(p_opt_lane, '')
      AND (p_run_id IS NULL OR lt.run_id = p_run_id)
      AND lt.status IN ('filled', 'submitted')
      AND s.name = 'Open'
      AND a.name IN ('Long', 'Short')
      AND rem.qty > 0;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION logic_open_notional_exposure(INTEGER, BOOLEAN, TEXT, BIGINT) IS
'РЎСѓРјРјР°СЂРЅС‹Р№ РЅРѕРјРёРЅР°Р» РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚С‹С… long+short (С†РµРЅР° РІС…РѕРґР°). РџРѕС‚РѕР»РѕРє: Р±Р°Р·Р° Г— (%/100) Г— max_open_positions вЂ” РѕРґРёРЅР°РєРѕРІРѕ РґР»СЏ long Рё short. p_run_id вЂ” С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РґР»СЏ is_test.';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_open_short_entry_notional(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_is_test BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE)
RETURNS NUMERIC
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
    v_notional NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    SELECT GREATEST(0, COALESCE(SUM(rem.qty * lt.price), 0))
    INTO v_notional
    FROM logic_trades lt
    JOIN sides s ON s.id = lt.side_id
    JOIN actions a ON a.id = lt.action_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT GREATEST(
            lt.quantity - COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(l.quantity)
                FROM logic_trade_lots l
                WHERE l.open_trade_id = lt.id
            ), 0),
            0
        ) AS qty
    ) rem
    WHERE lt.logic_id = p_logic_id
      AND NOT lt.is_shadow
      AND lt.is_test = COALESCE(p_is_test, FALSE)
      AND COALESCE(lt.opt_lane, '') = ''
      AND lt.status IN ('filled', 'submitted')
      AND s.name = 'Open'
      AND a.name = 'Short'
      AND rem.qty > 0;
    RETURN COALESCE(v_notional, 0);
END;
$$;

routines.description: JSON-РјР°СЃСЃРёРІ РёСЃС‚РѕСЂРёРё OPT/РїР°СЂР°РјРµС‚СЂРѕРІ РґР»СЏ РѕС‚С‡С‘С‚Р°; РїСЂРё РїСѓСЃС‚РѕР№ РёСЃС‚РѕСЂРёРё вЂ” РІРёСЂС‚СѓР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ СЃРЅРёРјРѕРє.
routines.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_opt_param_history_for_report(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_run_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
    v_rows JSONB;
    v_state JSONB;
BEGIN
    -- 1) РЎРѕР±С‹С‚РёСЏ СЌС‚РѕРіРѕ РїСЂРѕРіРѕРЅР° (СЃРЅРёРјРѕРє СЃС‚Р°СЂС‚Р° + promote СЃ run_id, РµСЃР»Рё Р±СѓРґСѓС‚)
    IF p_run_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', h.id,
                    'logic_id', h.logic_id,
                    'run_id', h.run_id,
                    'bar_dt', to_char(h.bar_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),
                    'event_kind', h.event_kind,
                    'lane', h.lane,
                    'params', h.params,
                    'params_prev', h.params_prev,
                    'opt_specs', h.opt_specs,
                    'formulas', h.formulas,
                    'champion_finres', h.champion_finres,
                    'winner_finres', h.winner_finres,
                    'created_at', to_char(h.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
                )
                ORDER BY h.created_at, h.id
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        )
        INTO v_rows
        FROM logic_opt_param_history h
        WHERE h.logic_id = p_logic_id
          AND h.run_id = p_run_id;
        IF v_rows IS NOT NULL AND v_rows <> '[]'::jsonb THEN
            RETURN v_rows;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- 2) Live promote (run_id IS NULL) + Р»СЋР±С‹Рµ СЃРЅРёРјРєРё Р»РѕРіРёРєРё вЂ” РґР»СЏ РћС‚С‡С‘С‚Р° Р±РµР· run / СЃС‚Р°СЂС‹С… РїСЂРѕРіРѕРЅРѕРІ
    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', h.id,
                'logic_id', h.logic_id,
                'run_id', h.run_id,
                'bar_dt', to_char(h.bar_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),
                'event_kind', h.event_kind,
                'lane', h.lane,
                'params', h.params,
                'params_prev', h.params_prev,
                'opt_specs', h.opt_specs,
                'formulas', h.formulas,
                'champion_finres', h.champion_finres,
                'winner_finres', h.winner_finres,
                'created_at', to_char(h.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
            )
            ORDER BY h.created_at, h.id
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    )
    INTO v_rows
    FROM logic_opt_param_history h
    WHERE h.logic_id = p_logic_id
      AND (p_run_id IS NULL OR h.run_id IS NULL);

    IF v_rows IS NOT NULL AND v_rows <> '[]'::jsonb THEN
        RETURN v_rows;
    END IF;

    -- 3) Fallback: РѕРґРёРЅ СЃРЅРёРјРѕРє В«РЅР° Р»РµС‚СѓВ» Р±РµР· INSERT
    v_state := logic_opt_collect_formula_state(p_logic_id);
    RETURN jsonb_build_array(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'id', NULL,
            'logic_id', p_logic_id,
            'run_id', p_run_id,
            'bar_dt', NULL,
            'event_kind', 'snapshot',
            'lane', '',
            'params', COALESCE(v_state->'bases', '{}'::jsonb),
            'params_prev', NULL,
            'opt_specs', COALESCE(v_state->'opt', '{}'::jsonb),
            'formulas', COALESCE(v_state->'formulas', '[]'::jsonb),
            'champion_finres', NULL,
            'winner_finres', NULL,
            'created_at', to_char(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
        )
    );
END;
$$;

routines.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_security_inversion_enter_shadow(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_security_id INTEGER,
    p_timeframe_id INTEGER,
    p_track_before NUMERIC,
    p_track_after NUMERIC,
    p_reason TEXT,
    p_position_side TEXT DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS VOID
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE
    v_side TEXT;
BEGIN
    v_side := logic_normalize_position_side(p_position_side);
    -- Keep real_trading_inverted: crossing zero later toggles it.
    IF v_side = 'long' THEN
        UPDATE logic_securities
        SET real_trading_paused = TRUE,
            real_trading_paused_long = TRUE,
            stop_resume_equity_long = p_track_before,
            stop_resume_baseline_long = p_track_after,
            stop_resume_triggered_at_long = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE logic_id = p_logic_id
          AND security_id = p_security_id;
    ELSIF v_side = 'short' THEN
        UPDATE logic_securities
        SET real_trading_paused = TRUE,
            real_trading_paused_short = TRUE,
            stop_resume_equity_short = p_track_before,
            stop_resume_baseline_short = p_track_after,
            stop_resume_triggered_at_short = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE logic_id = p_logic_id
          AND security_id = p_security_id;
    ELSE
        -- Legacy whole-paper shadow (both sides)
        UPDATE logic_securities
        SET real_trading_paused = TRUE,
            real_trading_paused_long = TRUE,
            real_trading_paused_short = TRUE,
            stop_resume_equity = p_track_before,
            stop_resume_baseline = p_track_after,
            stop_resume_triggered_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            stop_resume_equity_long = p_track_before,
            stop_resume_baseline_long = p_track_after,
            stop_resume_triggered_at_long = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            stop_resume_equity_short = p_track_before,
            stop_resume_baseline_short = p_track_after,
            stop_resume_triggered_at_short = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE logic_id = p_logic_id
          AND security_id = p_security_id;
    END IF;

    PERFORM logic_trade_log(
        p_logic_id,
        'stop.inversion_shadow',
        p_reason,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'security_id', p_security_id,
            'scope', 'security_inversion',
            'phase', 'shadow',
            'position_side', v_side,
            'track_before', p_track_before,
            'track_after', p_track_after
        ),
        p_security_id,
        p_timeframe_id
    );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_short_position_qty(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_security_id INTEGER,
    p_is_shadow BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    p_is_test BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    p_opt_lane TEXT DEFAULT '')
RETURNS NUMERIC
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN s.name = 'Open' AND a.name = 'Short' THEN lt.quantity
            WHEN s.name = 'Close' AND a.name = 'Short' THEN -lt.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END
    ), 0), 0)
    FROM logic_trades lt
    JOIN sides s ON s.id = lt.side_id
    JOIN actions a ON a.id = lt.action_id
    WHERE lt.logic_id = p_logic_id
      AND lt.security_id = p_security_id
      AND lt.is_shadow = p_is_shadow
      AND lt.is_test = p_is_test
      AND COALESCE(lt.opt_lane, '') = COALESCE(p_opt_lane, '')
      AND lt.status IN ('filled', 'submitted');
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_trade_log(p_logic_id INTEGER,
    p_operation TEXT,
    p_message TEXT,
    p_payload JSONB DEFAULT NULL,
    p_security_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_timeframe_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS VOID
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    -- РЁСѓРј РЅР° РєР°Р¶РґРѕР№ Р±СѓРјР°РіРµ/СЃРёРіРЅР°Р»Рµ Р±Р»РѕРєРёСЂСѓРµС‚ UI (СЂР°СЃРєСЂС‹С‚РёРµ РіСЂР°С„РёРєР°) РїСЂРё РІРєР»СЋС‡С‘РЅРЅРѕРј tech log
    IF p_operation IN (
        'trade.signal_skip',
        'trade.signal_hit',
        'trade.not_ready',
        'trade.prices.loaded',
        'trade.indicator.synced',
        'trade.bar_skip'
    ) THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    PERFORM app_tech_log_event(
        'logic:' || COALESCE(p_logic_id::TEXT, '0') || ':trade',
        p_operation,
        p_message,
        'postgresql',
        'event',
        p_logic_id,
        p_security_id,
        p_timeframe_id,
        p_payload
    );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_trade_open_remaining_qty_at(p_open_trade_id BIGINT,
    p_at_bar TIMESTAMP)
RETURNS NUMERIC
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $fn$
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN lt.id IS NULL OR lt.bar_dt > p_at_bar THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(
            lt.quantity - COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(l.quantity)
                FROM logic_trade_lots l
                JOIN logic_trades c ON c.id = l.close_trade_id
                WHERE l.open_trade_id = lt.id
                  AND c.bar_dt <= p_at_bar
            ), 0),
            0
        )
    END
    FROM logic_trades lt
    WHERE lt.id = p_open_trade_id;
$fn$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION logic_trade_open_remaining_qty_at(BIGINT, TIMESTAMP) IS
'Open lot remaining qty as of p_at_bar (closes with bar_dt > p_at_bar ignored).';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_trade_sync_point_count(p_tf_sec INTEGER)

    SELECT CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(p_tf_sec, 0) <= 60 THEN 400
        WHEN p_tf_sec <= 120 THEN 300
        WHEN p_tf_sec <= 300 THEN 200
        ELSE 150
    END;

routines.name: logic_trades_finres_anomalies
routines.description: Р‘РѕРµРІС‹Рµ Close-СЃРґРµР»РєРё СЃ РїРѕРґРѕР·СЂРёС‚РµР»СЊРЅС‹Рј FinRes: Р±РµР· РїР°РєРµС‚РѕРІ РёР»Рё РІРЅРµ С„РёР·РёС‡РµСЃРєРё РІРѕР·РјРѕР¶РЅРѕРіРѕ РґРёР°РїР°Р·РѕРЅР° С†РµРЅ (NULL = РІСЃРµ Р»РѕРіРёРєРё)
routines.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logic_trades_finres_anomalies(p_logic_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS TABLE(
    logic_id INTEGER,
    close_trade_id BIGINT,
    security_id INTEGER,
    executed_at TIMESTAMP,
    quantity NUMERIC,
    price NUMERIC,
    financial_result NUMERIC,
    commission NUMERIC,
    lots_count BIGINT,
    reason TEXT
)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    WITH close_side AS (
        SELECT id FROM sides WHERE name = 'Close' LIMIT 1
    ),
    closes AS (
        SELECT
            lt.id AS close_trade_id,
            lt.logic_id,
            lt.security_id,
            lt.executed_at,
            lt.quantity,
            lt.price,
            COALESCE(lt.financial_result, 0) AS finres,
            COALESCE(lt.commission, 0) AS comm,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logic_trade_lots l WHERE l.close_trade_id = lt.id) AS lots_count,
            COALESCE((
                SELECT MAX(ot.price)
                FROM logic_trade_lots l
                JOIN logic_trades ot ON ot.id = l.open_trade_id
                WHERE l.close_trade_id = lt.id
            ), lt.price) AS max_open_px
        FROM logic_trades lt
        WHERE COALESCE(lt.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
          AND COALESCE(lt.is_shadow, FALSE) = FALSE
          AND lt.status = 'filled'
          AND lt.side_id = (SELECT id FROM close_side)
          AND (p_logic_id IS NULL OR lt.logic_id = p_logic_id)
    )
    SELECT
        c.logic_id,
        c.close_trade_id,
        c.security_id,
        c.executed_at,
        c.quantity,
        c.price,
        c.finres AS financial_result,
        c.comm AS commission,
        c.lots_count,
        CASE
            WHEN c.finres <> 0 AND c.lots_count = 0
                THEN 'finres_without_lots'
            WHEN abs(c.finres) > c.quantity * GREATEST(c.price, c.max_open_px) + c.comm + 0.01
                THEN 'finres_out_of_bounds'
        END AS reason
    FROM closes c
    WHERE c.finres <> 0
      AND (
        c.lots_count = 0
        OR abs(c.finres) > c.quantity * GREATEST(c.price, c.max_open_px) + c.comm + 0.01
      )
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION logic_trades_finres_anomalies(INTEGER) IS
'Р‘РѕРµРІС‹Рµ Close-СЃРґРµР»РєРё СЃ РїРѕРґРѕР·СЂРёС‚РµР»СЊРЅС‹Рј FinRes: Р±РµР· РїР°РєРµС‚РѕРІ РёР»Рё РІРЅРµ С„РёР·РёС‡РµСЃРєРё РІРѕР·РјРѕР¶РЅРѕРіРѕ РґРёР°РїР°Р·РѕРЅР° С†РµРЅ (NULL = РІСЃРµ Р»РѕРіРёРєРё)';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION moex_forts_base_interval(p_requested INTEGER)
RETURNS INTEGER
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN p_requested IS NULL THEN 1
        WHEN p_requested IN (1, 10, 60, 24, 7, 31, 4) THEN p_requested
        WHEN p_requested < 10 THEN 1
        WHEN p_requested < 60 THEN 10
        ELSE 60
    END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION poly_load_market_array(p_field TEXT,
    p_security_id INTEGER,
    p_timeframe_id INTEGER,
    p_end_dt TIMESTAMP,
    p_bars INTEGER)
RETURNS NUMERIC[]
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
    v_arr NUMERIC[];
    v_field TEXT := lower(btrim(p_field));
BEGIN
    SELECT array_agg(x.v ORDER BY x.dt)
    INTO v_arr
    FROM (
        SELECT p.dt,
               CASE v_field
                   WHEN 'pp' THEN p.close_price
                   WHEN 'oo' THEN p.open_price
                   WHEN 'hh' THEN p.high_price
                   WHEN 'll' THEN p.low_price
                   WHEN 'vv' THEN p.volume::NUMERIC
                   ELSE NULL
               END AS v
        FROM prices p
        WHERE p.security_id = p_security_id
          AND p.timeframe_id = p_timeframe_id
          AND p.dt <= p_end_dt
        ORDER BY p.dt DESC
        LIMIT p_bars
    ) x;
    RETURN COALESCE(v_arr, ARRAY[]::NUMERIC[]);
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION poly_load_market_dts(p_security_id INTEGER,
    p_timeframe_id INTEGER,
    p_end_dt TIMESTAMP,
    p_bars INTEGER)
RETURNS TIMESTAMP[]
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(x.dt ORDER BY x.dt), ARRAY[]::TIMESTAMP[])
    FROM (
        SELECT p.dt
        FROM prices p
        WHERE p.security_id = p_security_id
          AND p.timeframe_id = p_timeframe_id
          AND p.dt <= p_end_dt
        ORDER BY p.dt DESC
        LIMIT p_bars
    ) x;
$$;

routines.description: РўРµСЃС‚ РІС‹С‡РёСЃР»РёРјС‹С… РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂРѕРІ: Р»СѓС‡С€РёР№ С…РѕРґ РґРѕ РєСЂР°Р№РЅРµР№ С‚РѕС‡РєРё СЃСЂРµРґРё Р·Р°РіСЂСѓР¶РµРЅРЅС‹С… Р±СѓРґСѓС‰РёС… СЃРІРµС‡РµР№, % РіРѕРґРѕРІС‹С… РїРѕ РІСЂРµРјРµРЅРё СѓРґРµСЂР¶Р°РЅРёСЏ, РїРѕСЂРѕРі СЃРёРіРЅР°Р»РѕРІ Рё РѕР±СЂРµР·РєР° РІС‹Р±СЂРѕСЃРѕРІ; p_logic_id вЂ” СЋРЅРёРІРµСЂСЃ РїР°СЂ РѕРґРЅРѕР№ Р»РѕРіРёРєРё (NULL вЂ” РІСЃРµ Р»РѕРіРёРєРё; РµСЃР»Рё Р»РѕРіРёРє РЅРµС‚ вЂ” РѕС‚РєР°С‚ Рє Р±СѓРјР°РіР°Рј СЃ РЅРµРґР°РІРЅРёРјРё СЃРІРµС‡Р°РјРё, Р»СЋР±РѕР№ Р°РєС‚РёРІРЅС‹Р№ РўР¤, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЃС‡РёС‚Р°С‚СЊ Р±РµР· РїСЂРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏ); p_indicator_id вЂ” СЃС‡РёС‚Р°С‚СЊ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЌС‚РѕС‚ РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂ РїРѕ РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРёРґРЅРµРІРЅС‹Рј Р±СѓРјР°РіР°Рј СЃРѕ СЃРІРµР¶РёРјРё M1 (СЂСѓС‡РЅРѕР№ СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚ РїРѕ РєРЅРѕРїРєРµ), p_timeframe_ids вЂ” РѕРіСЂР°РЅРёС‡РёС‚СЊ РЅР°Р±РѕСЂ РўР¤ (РїРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ РґР»СЏ СЂСѓС‡РЅРѕРіРѕ СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚Р° M1..H1); РЅР°РїРѕР»РЅСЏРµС‚ indicator_rating_sample / indicator_rating / indicator_rating_timeframe (СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРі РІ СЂР°Р·СЂРµР·Рµ РўР¤ + РѕРєРЅРѕ СЃРІРµС‡РµР№) / indicator_rating_universe (Р±СѓРјР°РіРё СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚Р°)
routines.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION run_indicator_rating_test(p_max_indicators INTEGER DEFAULT 200,
    p_max_securities INTEGER DEFAULT 200,
    p_max_bars INTEGER DEFAULT 500,
    p_bars_window INTEGER DEFAULT 5000,
    p_min_signals INTEGER DEFAULT 5,
    p_max_annual_pct NUMERIC DEFAULT 1000,
    p_logic_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_indicator_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_timeframe_ids INTEGER[] DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS INTEGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE
    v_now TIMESTAMP := LOCALTIMESTAMP;
    v_ind RECORD;
    v_pair RECORD;
    v_series_t TEXT;
    v_cond_t TEXT;
    v_series_c TEXT;
    v_cond_c TEXT;
    v_simple_t BOOLEAN;
    v_op_t TEXT;
    v_ppleft_t BOOLEAN;
    v_simple_c BOOLEAN;
    v_op_c TEXT;
    v_ppleft_c BOOLEAN;
    v_vt_t INTEGER;
    v_vt_c INTEGER;
    v_expr_t TEXT;
    v_expr_c TEXT;
    v_cap_sql TEXT;
    v_sql TEXT;
    v_processed INTEGER := 0;
    v_bars INTEGER := GREATEST(50, COALESCE(p_max_bars, 500));
    v_window INTEGER := GREATEST(50, COALESCE(p_bars_window, 5000));
    v_min_signals INTEGER := GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p_min_signals, 5));
    v_cap NUMERIC := p_max_annual_pct;
    v_year NUMERIC := 365.25 * 24 * 3600;
    v_slices INTEGER;
    v_samples INTEGER;
    v_rating NUMERIC;
    v_avg_all NUMERIC;
    v_best_side TEXT;
    v_best_kind TEXT;
    v_best_time TEXT;
    v_pb INTEGER;
    v_pf TIMESTAMP;
    v_pt TIMESTAMP;
    v_tf INTEGER;
    v_tf_slices INTEGER;
    v_tf_samples INTEGER;
    v_tf_rating NUMERIC;
    v_tf_avg NUMERIC;
    v_tf_side TEXT;
    v_tf_kind TEXT;
    v_tf_time TEXT;
BEGIN
    -- СЃСЌРјРїР»С‹ Р¶РёРІСѓС‚ СЃСѓС‚РєРё (РєР°Рє РїСЂРѕС‡РёРµ РґРёР°РіРЅРѕСЃС‚РёС‡РµСЃРєРёРµ Р·Р°РїРёСЃРё)
    DELETE FROM indicator_rating_sample
    WHERE computed_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24 hours';

    v_cap_sql := CASE WHEN v_cap IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE v_cap::TEXT END;

    -- Р®РЅРёРІРµСЂСЃ РїР°СЂ (Р±СѓРјР°РіР° Г— РўР¤) СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµРј РћР”РРќ СЂР°Р·. РСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРє вЂ” Р°РєС‚РёРІРЅС‹Рµ Р»РѕРіРёРєРё;
    -- РµСЃР»Рё С‚Р°РєРёС… РїР°СЂ РЅРµС‚ (РЅРµС‚ РІРєР»СЋС‡С‘РЅРЅС‹С…/СЃРёРіРЅР°Р»СЊРЅС‹С… Р»РѕРіРёРє), РѕС‚РєР°С‚С‹РІР°РµРјСЃСЏ РЅР°
    -- Р±СѓРјР°РіРё, РїРѕ РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹Рј РЅРµРґР°РІРЅРѕ Р±С‹Р»Рё СЃРІРµС‡Рё (Р»СЋР±РѕР№ Р°РєС‚РёРІРЅС‹Р№ РўР¤) вЂ” СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРі
    -- СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ РІСЃРµРіРґР°, Р±РµР· РїСЂРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏ РјР°С€РёРЅРЅРѕРіРѕ РІСЂРµРјРµРЅРё.
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS irt_pairs;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS irt_window;
    CREATE TEMP TABLE irt_pairs (
        security_id INTEGER,
        tf INTEGER,
        logic_id INTEGER
    ) ON COMMIT DROP;
    CREATE TEMP TABLE irt_window (
        tf INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        bars INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        from_dt TIMESTAMP,
        to_dt TIMESTAMP
    ) ON COMMIT DROP;

    IF p_indicator_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        -- #1011: СЂСѓС‡РЅРѕР№ СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚ СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРіР° РћР”РќРћР“Рћ РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂР° РїРѕ РєРЅРѕРїРєРµ. Р®РЅРёРІРµСЂСЃ вЂ”
        -- Р±СѓРјР°РіРё СЃРѕ СЃРІРµР¶РёРјРё M1-СЃРІРµС‡Р°РјРё Г— РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРёРґРЅРµРІРЅС‹Рµ РўР¤ (РїРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ M1..H1).
        -- РЎС‚Р°СЂС€РёРµ РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРёРґРЅРµРІРЅС‹Рµ СЃРІРµС‡Рё Р°РіСЂРµРіРёСЂСѓСЋС‚СЃСЏ РёР· M1 Р”Рћ РІС‹Р·РѕРІР° (РѕР±С‘СЂС‚РєР°).
        INSERT INTO irt_pairs (security_id, tf, logic_id)
        SELECT s.security_id, t.tf_id, NULL
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT p.security_id
            FROM prices p
            WHERE p.timeframe_id = 1 AND p.close_price > 0
              AND p.dt >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '3 days'
            ORDER BY p.security_id
            LIMIT GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p_max_securities, 200))
        ) s
        CROSS JOIN unnest(COALESCE(p_timeframe_ids, indicator_rating_intraday_timeframes())) AS t(tf_id)
        ORDER BY s.security_id, t.tf_id;
    ELSE
        INSERT INTO irt_pairs (security_id, tf, logic_id)
        SELECT ls.security_id, logic_resolve_timeframe_id(l.id), min(l.id)
        FROM logics l
        JOIN logic_securities ls ON ls.logic_id = l.id AND ls.is_active = TRUE
        WHERE p_logic_id IS NULL OR l.id = p_logic_id
        GROUP BY ls.security_id, logic_resolve_timeframe_id(l.id)
        HAVING logic_resolve_timeframe_id(l.id) IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY ls.security_id, 2
        LIMIT GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p_max_securities, 200));

        IF p_logic_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM irt_pairs) THEN
            INSERT INTO irt_pairs (security_id, tf, logic_id)
            SELECT p.security_id, p.timeframe_id, NULL
            FROM prices p
            JOIN timeframes tf ON tf.id = p.timeframe_id AND COALESCE(tf.is_active, TRUE)
            WHERE p.close_price > 0
              AND p.dt >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '3 days'
            GROUP BY p.security_id, p.timeframe_id
            ORDER BY count(*) DESC
            LIMIT GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p_max_securities, 200));
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- РћРіСЂР°РЅРёС‡РµРЅРёРµ РЅР°Р±РѕСЂР° РўР¤ (РґР»СЏ СЂСѓС‡РЅРѕРіРѕ СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚Р° РѕРґРЅРѕРіРѕ РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂР° вЂ” M1..H1).
    IF p_timeframe_ids IS NOT NULL THEN
        DELETE FROM irt_pairs WHERE NOT (tf = ANY(p_timeframe_ids));
    END IF;

    -- Р РµР№С‚РёРЅРіСѓРµРј Р’РЎР• РІС‹С‡РёСЃР»РёРјС‹Рµ РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂС‹ (РІ С‚.С‡. Р·Р°РґРµР№СЃС‚РІРѕРІР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ СЃРёРіРЅР°Р»Р°РјРё
    -- Р»РѕРіРёРє): СЃРёРіРЅР°Р»СЊРЅР°СЏ/РёСЃСЃР»РµРґРѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊСЃРєР°СЏ Р»РѕРіРёРєР° РЅРµ В«СЂР°СЃС…РѕРґСѓРµС‚В» РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂ.
    FOR v_ind IN
        SELECT i.id
        FROM indicators i
        WHERE COALESCE(i.is_active, TRUE)
          AND (p_indicator_id IS NULL OR i.id = p_indicator_id)
          AND (COALESCE(btrim(i.formula), '') <> '' OR COALESCE(btrim(i.script), '') <> '')
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM indicator_value_types ivt
              WHERE ivt.indicator_id = i.id AND ivt.is_threshold = FALSE
          )
        ORDER BY i.id
        LIMIT GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p_max_indicators, 200))
    LOOP
        v_processed := v_processed + 1;

        SELECT f.series, f.condition INTO v_series_t, v_cond_t
        FROM indicator_signal_series_and_condition(v_ind.id, 'trend') f;
        SELECT f.series, f.condition INTO v_series_c, v_cond_c
        FROM indicator_signal_series_and_condition(v_ind.id, 'counter') f;

        SELECT s.is_simple, s.op, s.pp_left INTO v_simple_t, v_op_t, v_ppleft_t
        FROM indicator_simple_condition(v_cond_t) s;
        SELECT s.is_simple, s.op, s.pp_left INTO v_simple_c, v_op_c, v_ppleft_c
        FROM indicator_simple_condition(v_cond_c) s;

        v_vt_t := (SELECT ivt.id FROM indicator_value_types ivt
                   WHERE ivt.indicator_id = v_ind.id AND upper(ivt.code) = upper(v_series_t) LIMIT 1);
        v_vt_c := (SELECT ivt.id FROM indicator_value_types ivt
                   WHERE ivt.indicator_id = v_ind.id AND upper(ivt.code) = upper(v_series_c) LIMIT 1);

        -- СѓСЃР»РѕРІРёСЏ РїСЂРѕРІРµСЂРєРё СЃРёРіРЅР°Р»Р° (РїСЂРѕСЃС‚РѕРµ СЃСЂР°РІРЅРµРЅРёРµ вЂ” Р·Р°РёРЅР»Р°Р№РЅРµРЅРѕ, РёРЅР°С‡Рµ С„СѓРЅРєС†РёСЏ)
        v_expr_t := CASE WHEN v_simple_t
            THEN (CASE WHEN v_ppleft_t THEN '(b.close_price ' || v_op_t || ' b.tv)'
                       ELSE '(b.tv ' || v_op_t || ' b.close_price)' END)
            ELSE 'evaluate_signal_condition(' || quote_literal(v_cond_t) || ', b.close_price, b.tv)' END;
        v_expr_c := CASE WHEN v_simple_c
            THEN (CASE WHEN v_ppleft_c THEN '(b.close_price ' || v_op_c || ' b.cv)'
                       ELSE '(b.cv ' || v_op_c || ' b.close_price)' END)
            ELSE 'evaluate_signal_condition(' || quote_literal(v_cond_c) || ', b.close_price, b.cv)' END;

        FOR v_pair IN
            SELECT security_id, tf, logic_id FROM irt_pairs ORDER BY security_id, tf
        LOOP
            BEGIN
                -- Р—РЅР°С‡РµРЅРёСЏ РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂР°: РѕРґРёРЅ СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚ РЅР° РїР°СЂСѓ (Р±СѓРјР°РіР° Г— РўР¤).
                CALL ensure_security_indicator_series(v_pair.security_id, v_ind.id);
                UPDATE security_indicator_series
                SET param_period = COALESCE(param_period, 20)
                WHERE security_id = v_pair.security_id
                  AND indicator_id = v_ind.id
                  AND param_period IS NULL;
                CALL sync_security_indicator_series_for_indicator(
                    v_pair.security_id, v_ind.id, v_pair.tf, NULL, v_bars, TRUE
                );

                -- РўСЏР¶С‘Р»С‹Р№ Р·Р°РїСЂРѕСЃ СЃРѕР±РёСЂР°РµРј РєР°Рє РґРёРЅР°РјРёС‡РµСЃРєРёР№ SQL СЃ Р»РёС‚РµСЂР°Р»Р°РјРё: СЃС‚Р°С‚РёС‡РµСЃРєРёР№
                -- SQL РІ plpgsql РїР»Р°РЅРёСЂСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ СЃ РїР°СЂР°РјРµС‚СЂР°РјРё Рё РїРѕР»СѓС‡Р°РµС‚ РЅРµРіРѕРґРЅС‹Р№ РїР»Р°РЅ
                -- (РІ ~150 СЂР°Р· РјРµРґР»РµРЅРЅРµРµ). Р—РґРµСЃСЊ Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРёСЏ РёРЅР»Р°Р№РЅСЏС‚СЃСЏ РІ С‚РµРєСЃС‚ Р·Р°РїСЂРѕСЃР°.
                v_sql := format($sql$
INSERT INTO indicator_rating_sample (
    indicator_id, logic_id, security_id, timeframe_id,
    position_side, signal_kind, time_kind,
    signals_count, avg_annual_pct, best_annual_pct, computed_at
)
WITH tpl AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT day_of_week, time_from, time_to
    FROM logic_moex_equity_non_trading_template()
),
px_prices AS (
    SELECT p.dt, p.close_price, p.high_price, p.low_price, tf.sec AS tf_sec
    FROM prices p
    JOIN timeframes tf ON tf.id = p.timeframe_id
    WHERE p.security_id = %s AND p.timeframe_id = %s AND p.close_price > 0
    ORDER BY p.dt DESC
    LIMIT %s
),
px AS (
    SELECT pp.dt, pp.close_price, pp.high_price, pp.low_price, pp.tf_sec,
           iv1.value AS tv, iv2.value AS cv
    FROM px_prices pp
    LEFT JOIN indicator_values iv1
      ON iv1.security_id = %s AND iv1.timeframe_id = %s AND iv1.dt = pp.dt
     AND iv1.indicator_id = %s AND iv1.indicator_value_type_id = %s
    LEFT JOIN indicator_values iv2
      ON iv2.security_id = %s AND iv2.timeframe_id = %s AND iv2.dt = pp.dt
     AND iv2.indicator_id = %s AND iv2.indicator_value_type_id = %s
),
bars AS (
    SELECT dt, close_price, tf_sec, tv, cv, fut_hi, fut_lo,
        CASE WHEN high_price >= fut_hi THEN dt END AS hi_rec,
        CASE WHEN low_price  <= fut_lo THEN dt END AS lo_rec
    FROM (
        -- Р’РђР–РќРћ: РєР°РґСЂ В«1 FOLLOWING .. UNBOUNDED FOLLOWINGВ» РІ PG СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ O(n^2)
        -- Рё РІРµС€Р°РµС‚ Р·Р°РїСЂРѕСЃ. Р‘РµСЂС‘Рј СЌРєРІРёРІР°Р»РµРЅС‚ РІ РѕР±СЂР°С‚РЅРѕРј РїРѕСЂСЏРґРєРµ: СЃС‚СЂРѕРіРѕ Р±СѓРґСѓС‰РёРµ
        -- СЃРІРµС‡Рё = СЃС‚СЂРѕРєРё СЃ dt Р±РѕР»СЊС€Рµ С‚РµРєСѓС‰РµР№ = РїСЂРµРґС€РµСЃС‚РІСѓСЋС‰РёРµ РІ РїРѕСЂСЏРґРєРµ dt DESC.
        SELECT dt, close_price, high_price, low_price, tf_sec, tv, cv,
            max(high_price) OVER wf AS fut_hi,
            min(low_price)  OVER wf AS fut_lo
        FROM px
        WINDOW wf AS (ORDER BY dt DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
    ) w
),
bars2 AS (
    SELECT dt, close_price, tf_sec, tv, cv, fut_hi, fut_lo,
        min(hi_rec) OVER (ORDER BY dt DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS hi_dt,
        min(lo_rec) OVER (ORDER BY dt DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS lo_dt
    FROM bars
),
base0 AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM b.dt) >= 6 AND b.nontrade THEN 'weekend_nontrade'
             WHEN extract(isodow FROM b.dt) >= 6 THEN 'weekend_trade'
             WHEN b.nontrade THEN 'workday_nontrade'
             ELSE 'workday_trade' END AS time_kind,
        CASE WHEN b.tv IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE %s END AS is_trend,
        CASE WHEN b.cv IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE %s END AS is_counter,
        CASE WHEN b.hi_dt IS NULL THEN NULL
             ELSE (b.fut_hi - b.close_price) / b.close_price * 100
                  * (%s / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.hi_dt - b.dt)), b.tf_sec)) END AS up_raw,
        CASE WHEN b.lo_dt IS NULL THEN NULL
             ELSE (b.close_price - b.fut_lo) / b.close_price * 100
                  * (%s / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.lo_dt - b.dt)), b.tf_sec)) END AS down_raw
    FROM (
        SELECT b.*,
               EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tpl t
                       WHERE t.day_of_week = extract(isodow FROM b.dt)
                         AND b.dt::time BETWEEN t.time_from AND t.time_to) AS nontrade
        FROM bars2 b
    ) b
    WHERE b.hi_dt IS NOT NULL OR b.lo_dt IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        time_kind, is_trend, is_counter,
        CASE WHEN %s IS NULL THEN up_raw
             ELSE least(greatest(up_raw, -abs(%s)), abs(%s)) END AS gain_long,
        CASE WHEN %s IS NULL THEN down_raw
             ELSE least(greatest(down_raw, -abs(%s)), abs(%s)) END AS gain_short
    FROM base0
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        time_kind,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_trend AND gain_long IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER AS tl_n,
        avg(gain_long) FILTER (WHERE is_trend) AS tl_avg,
        max(gain_long) FILTER (WHERE is_trend) AS tl_max,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_trend AND gain_short IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER AS ts_n,
        avg(gain_short) FILTER (WHERE is_trend) AS ts_avg,
        max(gain_short) FILTER (WHERE is_trend) AS ts_max,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_counter AND gain_long IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER AS cl_n,
        avg(gain_long) FILTER (WHERE is_counter) AS cl_avg,
        max(gain_long) FILTER (WHERE is_counter) AS cl_max,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_counter AND gain_short IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER AS cs_n,
        avg(gain_short) FILTER (WHERE is_counter) AS cs_avg,
        max(gain_short) FILTER (WHERE is_counter) AS cs_max
    FROM base
    GROUP BY time_kind
)
SELECT %s, %s, %s, %s, s.position_side, s.signal_kind, s.time_kind,
       s.signals_count, s.avg_annual_pct, s.best_annual_pct, %s
FROM (
    SELECT time_kind, 'long'  AS position_side, 'trend'   AS signal_kind,
           tl_n AS signals_count, tl_avg AS avg_annual_pct, tl_max AS best_annual_pct
    FROM agg WHERE tl_n >= %s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time_kind, 'short', 'trend', ts_n, ts_avg, ts_max FROM agg WHERE ts_n >= %s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time_kind, 'long',  'counter', cl_n, cl_avg, cl_max FROM agg WHERE cl_n >= %s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time_kind, 'short', 'counter', cs_n, cs_avg, cs_max FROM agg WHERE cs_n >= %s
) s
ON CONFLICT (indicator_id, security_id, timeframe_id, position_side, signal_kind, time_kind)
DO UPDATE SET
    logic_id = EXCLUDED.logic_id,
    signals_count = EXCLUDED.signals_count,
    avg_annual_pct = EXCLUDED.avg_annual_pct,
    best_annual_pct = EXCLUDED.best_annual_pct,
    computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at
$sql$,
                    v_pair.security_id::TEXT, v_pair.tf::TEXT, v_window::TEXT,
                    v_pair.security_id::TEXT, v_pair.tf::TEXT, v_ind.id::TEXT, COALESCE(v_vt_t::TEXT, 'NULL'),
                    v_pair.security_id::TEXT, v_pair.tf::TEXT, v_ind.id::TEXT, COALESCE(v_vt_c::TEXT, 'NULL'),
                    v_expr_t, v_expr_c, v_year::TEXT, v_year::TEXT,
                    v_cap_sql, v_cap_sql, v_cap_sql,
                    v_cap_sql, v_cap_sql, v_cap_sql,
                    v_ind.id::TEXT, COALESCE(v_pair.logic_id::TEXT, 'NULL'),
                    v_pair.security_id::TEXT, v_pair.tf::TEXT, quote_literal(v_now::TEXT),
                    v_min_signals::TEXT, v_min_signals::TEXT, v_min_signals::TEXT, v_min_signals::TEXT
                );
                EXECUTE v_sql;

                -- РћРєРЅРѕ СЃРІРµС‡РµР№ РїР°СЂС‹ (РґР»СЏ СЃС‚Р°С‚РёСЃС‚РёРєРё СЂР°Р·РІРѕСЂРѕС‚Р° СЃС‚СЂРѕРєРё): СЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ
                -- РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРёС… СЃРІРµС‡РµР№ РўР¤ СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РІР·СЏС‚Рѕ РІ СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚ Рё РїРѕ РєР°РєРёРј РґР°С‚Р°Рј.
                SELECT count(*)::INTEGER, min(dt), max(dt)
                INTO v_pb, v_pf, v_pt
                FROM (
                    SELECT p.dt
                    FROM prices p
                    WHERE p.security_id = v_pair.security_id
                      AND p.timeframe_id = v_pair.tf
                      AND p.close_price > 0
                    ORDER BY p.dt DESC
                    LIMIT v_window
                ) z;

                INSERT INTO irt_window (tf, bars, from_dt, to_dt)
                VALUES (v_pair.tf, COALESCE(v_pb, 0), v_pf, v_pt)
                ON CONFLICT (tf) DO UPDATE SET
                    bars = GREATEST(irt_window.bars, EXCLUDED.bars),
                    from_dt = LEAST(irt_window.from_dt, EXCLUDED.from_dt),
                    to_dt = GREATEST(irt_window.to_dt, EXCLUDED.to_dt);
            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                CONTINUE;
            END;
        END LOOP;

        -- РђРіСЂРµРіР°С‚ РїРѕ РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂСѓ: СЂР°Р·СЂРµР· = СЃС‚РѕСЂРѕРЅР° Г— С‚РёРї СЃРёРіРЅР°Р»Р° Г— С‚РёРї РІСЂРµРјРµРЅРё,
        -- СѓСЃСЂРµРґРЅРµРЅРёРµ РїРѕ Р±СѓРјР°РіР°Рј; СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРі = РјР°РєСЃРёРјСѓРј СЃСЂРµРґРЅРµРіРѕ % РіРѕРґРѕРІС‹С….
        SELECT
            count(*)::INTEGER,
            COALESCE(sum(signals_count), 0)::INTEGER,
            max(slice_avg),
            sum(slice_avg * signals_count) / NULLIF(sum(signals_count), 0)
        INTO v_slices, v_samples, v_rating, v_avg_all
        FROM (
            SELECT position_side, signal_kind, time_kind,
                   avg(avg_annual_pct) AS slice_avg,
                   sum(signals_count) AS signals_count
            FROM indicator_rating_sample
            WHERE indicator_id = v_ind.id AND computed_at = v_now
            GROUP BY position_side, signal_kind, time_kind
        ) g;

        IF v_rating IS NOT NULL THEN
            SELECT position_side, signal_kind, time_kind
            INTO v_best_side, v_best_kind, v_best_time
            FROM (
                SELECT position_side, signal_kind, time_kind,
                       avg(avg_annual_pct) AS slice_avg
                FROM indicator_rating_sample
                WHERE indicator_id = v_ind.id AND computed_at = v_now
                GROUP BY position_side, signal_kind, time_kind
            ) g
            ORDER BY slice_avg DESC NULLS LAST
            LIMIT 1;

            INSERT INTO indicator_rating (
                indicator_id, rating, best_position_side, best_signal_kind, best_time_kind,
                slices_count, samples_count, avg_annual_pct, computed_at
            )
            VALUES (
                v_ind.id, v_rating, v_best_side, v_best_kind, v_best_time,
                v_slices, v_samples, v_avg_all, v_now
            )
            ON CONFLICT (indicator_id) DO UPDATE SET
                rating = EXCLUDED.rating,
                best_position_side = EXCLUDED.best_position_side,
                best_signal_kind = EXCLUDED.best_signal_kind,
                best_time_kind = EXCLUDED.best_time_kind,
                slices_count = EXCLUDED.slices_count,
                samples_count = EXCLUDED.samples_count,
                avg_annual_pct = EXCLUDED.avg_annual_pct,
                computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at;
        END IF;

        -- Р РµР№С‚РёРЅРі РїРѕ РєР°Р¶РґРѕРјСѓ РўР¤ РѕС‚РґРµР»СЊРЅРѕ + РѕРєРЅРѕ СЃРІРµС‡РµР№ вЂ” РґР»СЏ СЂР°Р·РІРѕСЂРѕС‚Р° СЃС‚СЂРѕРєРё
        -- РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂР° РІ СЃРїРёСЃРєРµ (РєР°РєРѕР№ РўР¤, РЅР° СЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРёС… СЃРІРµС‡Р°С…, СЃ РєР°РєРѕРіРѕ РїРѕ РєР°РєРѕРµ С‡РёСЃР»Рѕ).
        FOR v_tf IN
            SELECT DISTINCT s.timeframe_id
            FROM indicator_rating_sample s
            WHERE s.indicator_id = v_ind.id AND s.computed_at = v_now
        LOOP
            SELECT
                count(*)::INTEGER,
                COALESCE(sum(signals_count), 0)::INTEGER,
                max(slice_avg),
                sum(slice_avg * signals_count) / NULLIF(sum(signals_count), 0)
            INTO v_tf_slices, v_tf_samples, v_tf_rating, v_tf_avg
            FROM (
                SELECT position_side, signal_kind, time_kind,
                       avg(avg_annual_pct) AS slice_avg,
                       sum(signals_count) AS signals_count
                FROM indicator_rating_sample
                WHERE indicator_id = v_ind.id AND timeframe_id = v_tf AND computed_at = v_now
                GROUP BY position_side, signal_kind, time_kind
            ) g;

            IF v_tf_rating IS NOT NULL THEN
                SELECT position_side, signal_kind, time_kind
                INTO v_tf_side, v_tf_kind, v_tf_time
                FROM (
                    SELECT position_side, signal_kind, time_kind,
                           avg(avg_annual_pct) AS slice_avg
                    FROM indicator_rating_sample
                    WHERE indicator_id = v_ind.id AND timeframe_id = v_tf AND computed_at = v_now
                    GROUP BY position_side, signal_kind, time_kind
                ) g
                ORDER BY slice_avg DESC NULLS LAST
                LIMIT 1;

                INSERT INTO indicator_rating_timeframe (
                    indicator_id, timeframe_id, rating, best_position_side, best_signal_kind,
                    best_time_kind, slices_count, samples_count, avg_annual_pct,
                    bars_count, bars_from, bars_to, computed_at
                )
                SELECT v_ind.id, v_tf, v_tf_rating, v_tf_side, v_tf_kind, v_tf_time,
                       v_tf_slices, v_tf_samples, v_tf_avg,
                       COALESCE(w.bars, 0), w.from_dt, w.to_dt, v_now
                FROM (SELECT 1) one
                LEFT JOIN irt_window w ON w.tf = v_tf
                ON CONFLICT (indicator_id, timeframe_id) DO UPDATE SET
                    rating = EXCLUDED.rating,
                    best_position_side = EXCLUDED.best_position_side,
                    best_signal_kind = EXCLUDED.best_signal_kind,
                    best_time_kind = EXCLUDED.best_time_kind,
                    slices_count = EXCLUDED.slices_count,
                    samples_count = EXCLUDED.samples_count,
                    avg_annual_pct = EXCLUDED.avg_annual_pct,
                    bars_count = EXCLUDED.bars_count,
                    bars_from = EXCLUDED.bars_from,
                    bars_to = EXCLUDED.bars_to,
                    computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        -- #1006: СѓРЅРёРІРµСЂСЃСѓРј Р±СѓРјР°Рі, РїРѕ РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹Рј СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РїРѕСЃС‡РёС‚Р°РЅ СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРі (РїРµСЂРµР¶РёРІР°РµС‚
        -- РѕС‡РёСЃС‚РєСѓ indicator_rating_sample). РџРёС‚Р°РµС‚ СЃРѕР·РґР°РЅРёРµ Р»РѕРіРёРєРё РёР· Р»СѓС‡С€РёС… СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРіРѕРІ.
        INSERT INTO indicator_rating_universe (
            indicator_id, timeframe_id, security_id, logic_id, signals_count, computed_at
        )
        SELECT s.indicator_id, s.timeframe_id, s.security_id,
               min(s.logic_id), sum(s.signals_count), v_now
        FROM indicator_rating_sample s
        WHERE s.indicator_id = v_ind.id AND s.computed_at = v_now
        GROUP BY s.indicator_id, s.timeframe_id, s.security_id
        ON CONFLICT (indicator_id, timeframe_id, security_id) DO UPDATE SET
            logic_id = EXCLUDED.logic_id,
            signals_count = EXCLUDED.signals_count,
            computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at;
    END LOOP;

    RETURN v_processed;
END;
$$;

'РўРµСЃС‚ РІС‹С‡РёСЃР»РёРјС‹С… РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂРѕРІ: Р»СѓС‡С€РёР№ С…РѕРґ РґРѕ РєСЂР°Р№РЅРµР№ С‚РѕС‡РєРё СЃСЂРµРґРё Р·Р°РіСЂСѓР¶РµРЅРЅС‹С… Р±СѓРґСѓС‰РёС… СЃРІРµС‡РµР№, % РіРѕРґРѕРІС‹С… РїРѕ РІСЂРµРјРµРЅРё СѓРґРµСЂР¶Р°РЅРёСЏ, РїРѕСЂРѕРі СЃРёРіРЅР°Р»РѕРІ Рё РѕР±СЂРµР·РєР° РІС‹Р±СЂРѕСЃРѕРІ; p_logic_id вЂ” СЋРЅРёРІРµСЂСЃ РїР°СЂ РѕРґРЅРѕР№ Р»РѕРіРёРєРё (NULL вЂ” РІСЃРµ Р»РѕРіРёРєРё; РµСЃР»Рё Р»РѕРіРёРє РЅРµС‚ вЂ” РѕС‚РєР°С‚ Рє Р±СѓРјР°РіР°Рј СЃ РЅРµРґР°РІРЅРёРјРё СЃРІРµС‡Р°РјРё, Р»СЋР±РѕР№ Р°РєС‚РёРІРЅС‹Р№ РўР¤, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЃС‡РёС‚Р°С‚СЊ Р±РµР· РїСЂРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏ); p_indicator_id вЂ” СЃС‡РёС‚Р°С‚СЊ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЌС‚РѕС‚ РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂ РїРѕ РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРёРґРЅРµРІРЅС‹Рј Р±СѓРјР°РіР°Рј СЃРѕ СЃРІРµР¶РёРјРё M1 (СЂСѓС‡РЅРѕР№ СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚ РїРѕ РєРЅРѕРїРєРµ), p_timeframe_ids вЂ” РѕРіСЂР°РЅРёС‡РёС‚СЊ РЅР°Р±РѕСЂ РўР¤ (РїРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ РґР»СЏ СЂСѓС‡РЅРѕРіРѕ СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚Р° M1..H1); РЅР°РїРѕР»РЅСЏРµС‚ indicator_rating_sample / indicator_rating / indicator_rating_timeframe (СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРі РІ СЂР°Р·СЂРµР·Рµ РўР¤ + РѕРєРЅРѕ СЃРІРµС‡РµР№) / indicator_rating_universe (Р±СѓРјР°РіРё СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚Р°)';
